environment.description: Same EC2 instance type and AMI. Process launched via systemd unit with RootDirectory=/srv/jail/metrics-logger (bind-mounted minimal filesystem: /lib64, /tmp, /var/log/metrics.log only). The chroot target directory tree was populated using debootstrap --variant=minbase with only libc6 and coreutils. No /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, /proc, /sys, or /opt present in the jail. The systemd unit also specifies ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateDevices=yes, and NoNewPrivileges=yes. Note: the binary is still compiled without PIE (-no-pie) and without stack canaries (-fno-stack-protector), and ASLR is disabled system-wide. The format string vulnerability remains fully triggerable - %x and %n specifiers execute normally.
